diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py b/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py
index 6562186..e5a6678 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py
@@ -384,6 +384,7 @@ class RunState:
     failure_category: str | None = None
     last_batch_progressed: bool = True
     stagnant_batches: int = 0
+    stop_challenges: int = 0
 
 
 class EnvironmentResult(Protocol):
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
index f1a6340..f09057c 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
@@ -290,6 +290,29 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
             elif decision.action is ActionKind.REPLAN:
                 self._handle_replan(state, decision)
             else:
+                turns_left = self._options.max_turns - state.turn_count
+                if (
+                    decision.stop_category in {"blocked", "impossible"}
+                    and state.stop_challenges < 1
+                    and not state.finalization_started
+                    and turns_left > 10
+                ):
+                    state.stop_challenges += 1
+                    self._journal.append(
+                        "premature_stop_challenged",
+                        {
+                            "stop_category": decision.stop_category,
+                            "turns_remaining": turns_left,
+                        },
+                    )
+                    state.unresolved_errors.append(
+                        "Stop was not accepted: substantial budget remains and the task is "
+                        "solvable in this sandbox. Re-read the task, diagnose the actual "
+                        "blocker, and try a materially different approach (other tools, "
+                        "writing your own implementation, inspecting inputs more closely)."
+                    )
+                    self._notify(state)
+                    continue
                 state.final_summary = decision.summary or decision.rationale
                 return self._finish(
                     state,
